role: A post-open cross-evidence diagnostic on the exact 24 independently reproduced v201 five-camera failures. It asks whether an already sealed all-nine-camera classical K2 reconstruction supplies the missing physical information. It is not a deployable initializer, validation, test evidence, exact-call reduction, resource evidence, external generalization, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Do the sealed all-nine-camera full-DCT K2 fields pass the unchanged strict field, gradient, and observation limits on every one of the 24 v201 five-camera TGV2 failures?
reason_for_priority: v202 could not numerically close the five-camera row-space residual under its frozen LSQR contract and is inconclusive. Rather than tune that ill-conditioned solver or add another prior, v203 uses already independently sealed evidence to test the physically distinct intervention of four additional views.

data_contract.trajectory_role: historically exposed post-open development diagnostic only
data_contract.failure_roster_source: exact false entries of independently validated v201 tgv2_pdhg_reference strict mask

cost_accounting.operation: index and compare already sealed, independently validated metric arrays

fixed_decision_order: Any parent identity, metadata, shape, roster, global metric-mask consistency, five-camera cross-parent reproduction, finite, source-clean, tree-seal, release, or independent-comparison failure makes v203 inconclusive.

If all 24 all-nine-camera K2 cells pass the unchanged strict gate, conclude PASS_NINE_CAMERA_PHYSICAL_INFORMATION_HEADROOM_V203: four additional views remove every audited failure under this sealed classical K2 reference.
If between one and 23 all-nine-camera K2 cells pass, conclude MIXED_NINE_CAMERA_RESCUE_V203 and report the exact rescue roster.
If zero all-nine-camera K2 cells pass, conclude FAIL_NO_NINE_CAMERA_RESCUE_V203.

No outcome proves mathematical impossibility, deployability, exact-call reduction, wall/RSS benefit, external generalization, real BOST, paper success, first/SOTA/global uniqueness, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: Do not change the arm, sensor, 24-cell roster, or strict limits after results. A full rescue only authorizes a separately frozen variable-cardinality mechanism question; a mixed or zero rescue requires reporting the exact boundary rather than training a larger model.
